I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this small plot of tubers because one bag costs too much money and is meant for a much bigger field than my 0.08 hectares. I will spread manure from my homestead on this plot since I own the land and I want to keep the soil good, and I will plant the same root cuttings I saved from last season because they are free and they always grow well here. My children and I will do all the work ourselves—about 12 days over the season for planting, weeding, and harvesting—because hiring labor is too expensive when I have so little land and I must save my cash for other things.
